cards.ex: There are some exciting new technologies on the horizon in the medical field.
cards.exUz: Tibbiyot sohasida yaqin kelajakda juda qiziqarli yangi texnologiyalar paydo bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin kelajakda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa. Kelajakda ko'rinib turgan

cards.ex: The rise of social media influencers is definitely a sign of the times.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media ta'sirchilarining ko'payishi, albatta, davrning belgisi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi paytda odatiy yoki muhim bo'lgan narsa, davrning o'zgarishi

cards.ex: The company seems to have turned the corner after a difficult year.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qiyin yildan so'ng vaziyatni o'nglaganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan yaxshi tomonga o'zgarish, vaziyat yaxshilanmoqda

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project so we can meet the deadline.
cards.exUz: Kelishilgan muddatga yetishish uchun ushbu loyihani boshlaylik.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni boshlash, jarayonni harakatga keltirish

cards.ex: I decided to take a vacation for a change of pace.
cards.exUz: Zerikmaslik uchun ta'tilga chiqishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan boshqacha bo'lgan yangi narsa, zerikishni ketkazish

cards.ex: Investing in education is beneficial in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda foydali.

cards.ex: It's hard keeping up with all the latest technology.
cards.exUz: Barcha so'nggi texnologiyalardan xabardor bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lish, ushlab turish

cards.ex: It takes time to adapt to a new culture.
cards.exUz: Yangi madaniyatga moslashish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi sharoitlarga yoki vaziyatga ko'nikish, moslashish

cards.ex: The plans aren't set in stone yet, so we can still make changes.
cards.exUz: Rejalar hali qat'iy emas, shuning uchun biz hali ham o'zgartirishlar kirita olamiz.

cards.ex: Relationships grow stronger over time.
cards.exUz: Munosabatlar vaqt o'tishi bilan mustahkamlanadi.

cards.ex: I think that new diet is just a passing fad.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, bu yangi dieta shunchaki o'tkinchi moda.
cards.uzDef: Tezda mashhur bo'lib, tezda unutiladigan narsa

cards.ex: The sands of time are always moving, so make the most of each day.
cards.exUz: Vaqt doimo o'tib boradi, shuning uchun har bir kundan unumli foydalaning.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stuck to her guns and defended her ideas.
cards.exUz: Hamma rozi bo'lmasa ham, u o'z fikrida qat'iy turdi va o'z g'oyalarini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrida qat'iy turish, o'z nuqtai nazaringizni himoya qilish

cards.ex: The writing is on the wall for that company; they're going to go bankrupt soon.
cards.exUz: U kompaniya uchun oqibat ayon; ular tez orada bankrot bo'lishadi.
cards.term: the writing is on the wall
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning yomon oqibatlari kelajakda aniq ko'rinib turibdi

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.

cards.ex: There's been a shift in public opinion on climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha jamoatchilik fikrida o'zgarish bo'ldi.

cards.ex: That artist's work was really ahead of its time.
cards.exUz: U rassomning ishi o'z davriga nisbatan juda ilg'or edi.

cards.ex: Businesses need to move with the times to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Korxonalar raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun zamonga moslashishlari kerak.

cards.ex: The internet has brought about a sea change in the way we communicate.
cards.exUz: Internet bizning muloqot usulimizda tub o'zgarishlar olib keldi.

cards.ex: The economy is on the upswing after a period of recession.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot retsessiya davridan keyin o'sishda.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets worse.
cards.exUz: Bu muammo yomonlashishidan oldin uni ildizdan quritishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: She's a trendsetter in the fashion industry.
cards.exUz: U moda sanoatida trend yaratuvchi shaxs.
cards.uzDef: Yangi modalar va uslublarni boshlab beruvchi shaxs

cards.ex: Time flies when you're having fun!
cards.exUz: Qiziqarli bo'lganda vaqt tez o'tadi!

cards.ex: Seeing that old photo was a real blast from the past.
cards.exUz: O'sha eski suratni ko'rish o'tmishdan salom edi.

cards.ex: If you want to work here, you need to get with the program.
cards.exUz: Agar bu yerda ishlashni xohlasangiz, yangi qoidalarga ko'nikishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi qoidalarga yoki vaziyatga ko'nikish, moslashish

cards.ex: People often talk about the good old days, but I think now is great too.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ko'pincha oltin davrlar haqida gapirishadi, lekin menimcha hozir ham ajoyib.

cards.ex: The popularity of that singer is on the decline.
cards.exUz: U qo'shiqchining mashhurligi pasayishda.

cards.ex: The company managed to weather the storm and survive the recession.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qiyinchilikni yengib o'tdi va retsessiyadan omon qoldi.

cards.ex: The political landscape is constantly changing.
cards.exUz: Siyosiy vaziyat doimo o'zgarib turadi.

cards.ex: Learning a new language can be time-consuming.
cards.exUz: Yangi tilni o'rganish ko'p vaqt talab qilishi mumkin.
